annotations.title: Wait for a call to finish

description: Polls a call every few seconds until it reaches a final status (completed, failed, no_answer, busy, transferred, ended) or the timeout passes, then returns status, disconnection_reason, duration and the transcript if present. Use right after call2me_make_outbound_call. Does not affect the call. Pass call_ids (up to 10) to watch several calls at once; mode 'any' returns when one finishes, 'all' when every one has.

call_ids.description: Several call ids to watch in one wait (1-10).

mode.description: With call_ids: return when any call finishes (default) or when all have.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait at most (1-120 s). If it returns timed_out, call again.

name: call2me_wait_for_call
title: Wait for a call to finish
